notes.title: The swarm arrives
notes.content:
Added introductory hints for the core gameplay of the game for creating new saves
   Added tips on the location of restaurant menu editing functions and how to do it
   Added locations and tips for opening/closing, sleeping, and functions
   Added information about the location of the customer order function and the operation hints
   Added information about the location of the kitchen storage, the tasting function, and the operation tips
   Added information about the location of food aging information and tips on how to do it
   Added hints about how to get to the Market and what to do in the Market

New ingredient types have been added to the game, and old saves are available
   Added Spiders
   Added BearBugs
   Added GreenWorms
   Added BedBugs 
   Added Pupae

Some bug fixes and optimizations have been made
   Fixed the issue that the sound effect of the pot could not be adjusted
   Fixed an issue where some customers were unable to leave properly
   Fixed an issue where some conditions caused food to produce additional foul smells
   Fixed an issue where entering two ogres in a row would cause some of the game's data to be out of order
   Fixed an issue where some food on the barbecue would not change color properly
   Fixed an issue where sheep brains would give an error when cutting
   Raised the weight of cucumbers
   The weight of the wolf's leg has been reduced
   Changed the expression of guests when they are not satisfied with the freshness of the food served by the player, they no longer tell the player that "the food stinks".
   Added some missing translations for the English version
